objective: Bind maternal/infant delivery recipients and source service episodes to qualified core transfer lifecycle; gate declared destination resources/opening/fallback and escort coverage without replacing core ownership semantics.
interface_contract: B6.1–B6.3; CC-01/02; qualified core TransferManager/IdentityLedger/BirthMessageLedger and B4 escort duty. Physical occupancy and origin-claim release remain separate; checkpoint scope is core-ledger only.
steps: Add failing recipient/episode binding, split destinations, unavailable/reject/cancel/expiry/buffered ack/fallback and escort conservation controls.
Implement a thin clone/validate/commit boundary around core TransferManager with immutable profiles, actual-effect validation and explicit resource units.
Run affected target, core transfer contract and all-target Clippy; independently review before scoped hosted acceptance.

verification.oracle: Bound delivery routes, split/fallback lifecycle, availability/escort gates, retries and conservation pass.
Qualified core transfer lifecycle remains passing.

acceptance: Birth recipients map to stable typed person/source episode references; malformed or unrelated identities cannot request transfers.
Destination resources/availability and fallback destinations must be explicitly declared; unknown availability cannot grant.
Reordered/duplicate/late messages use qualified core semantics and cannot duplicate domain effects.
Actual departures/handovers require configured same-worker escort coverage where declared.
Person ownership/location and origin/destination/escort claims reconcile; no transfer equals birth or automatic family discharge.
size_exception: Six paths bind one domain adapter, declaration, one behavior target, packet, evidence and mandatory inventory; no upstream/shared-source writes.
